author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Bitget says suspected North Korea-linked actors stole $351.6M from hot and warm wallets. Withdrawals were suspended while Mandiant investigates. The company detected unauthorized transfers on September 24 and temporarily suspended withdrawals. Bitget said customer […]
title: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget Says North Korea-Linked Hackers Stole $351.6 Million

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Attackers hijacked Ukrainian websites to deliver a fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA that installs Psychedelic Stealer and steals browser and crypto credentials. Psychedelic Stealer is being distributed through compromised Ukrainian business websites. Attackers injected hidden iframes into legitimate pages and used them to display a fake Cloudflare verification screen to visitors. The affected sites included a hair-treatment […]
title: ClickFix Campaign Abuses Trusted Websites to Deploy Psychedelic Stealer

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: CARBONATO exploits exposed Docker daemons, installs an AI agent, steals API keys and spreads across networks with autonomous command execution. CARBONATO is a Docker-based botnet that has been active since at least October 2024. ThreatDown discovered the operation after finding an unauthenticated container registry exposed to the internet. The registry contained the attackers’ entire toolchain […]
title: AI-Powered CARBONATO Botnet Steals Credentials to Fund Its Own LLM Gateway
